question: Ship the mock Describe specs agent action, a scriptable surface, or neither?
context: The redline mock Export section has a Describe specs button and says every control is one API call so the agent can measure a capture and hand back the spec list. No agent integration exists in Photonz. Spec: docs/design/next-measure.md section 7.

options.label: Omit for v1
options.detail: Ship Copy as spec list (deterministic text export) only. The agent button returns when there is real agent infrastructure to hand the list to.

options.label: Spec-list export plus a scriptable surface
options.detail: Also expose measurements through a scriptable command (URL scheme or CLI) so an external agent can pull the spec list without the UI; the button itself still waits.

options.label: Build the agent action now
options.detail: An in-app action that sends the capture + measurements to an agent and returns a written spec description. Largest scope; no agent plumbing exists in the app today.
